blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: This skirt is not completely black but slightly bluish.
exercises.ru: Эта юбка не полностью чёрная, ___ слегка синеватая.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's doable, but not easy.
exercises.ru: Это осуществимо, ___ не просто.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Don't make that face or it's going to get stuck like that.
exercises.ru: Не кривляйся, ___ так и останешься.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That's a marker, not a pen.
exercises.ru: Это маркер, ___ не ручка.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom started briskly, but quickly fizzled out.
exercises.ru: Том резво начал, ___ быстро выдохся.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He looks wealthy, but actually he's not.
exercises.ru: Он выглядит благоденствующим, ___ на самом деле это не так.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Not only did I eat pilaf, but I also ate kebabs.
exercises.ru: Я не только поел плов, ___ также съел шашлык.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tortoises are reptiles, not amphibians.
exercises.ru: Черепахи — пресмыкающиеся, ___ не земноводные.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You of all people should know.
exercises.ru: Кто-кто, ___ уж ты-то должна знать.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is Scottish, but he doesn't speak Scots.
exercises.ru: Том - шотландец, ___ не говорит по-шотландски.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Then the doll's eyes began to shine like fireflies, and suddenly it became alive.
exercises.ru: ___ потом глаза куклы засияли, как светлячки, и внезапно она ожила.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Pride tends to develop into hubris, which is close kin to madness.
exercises.ru: Гордость порою переходит в гордыню, ___ гордыня — родственник безумию.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It is not progress but regression.
exercises.ru: Это не продвижение вперёд, ___ ухудшение.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Those were Veronica's words, not mine.
exercises.ru: Это были слова Вероники, ___ не мои.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Maybe you ought to just calm the hell down, my brother.
exercises.ru: ___ может ты просто нахер успокоишься, брателло!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Besides being ignorant, he is too proud.
exercises.ru: Он не только невежественен, ___ ещё и слишком горделив.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My father shaves with an electric shaver, but I generally use a razor.
exercises.ru: Мой отец бреется электробритвой, ___ я использую обычный станок для бритья.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Marina is from Russia and Clarissa is from Sweden.
exercises.ru: Марина из России, ___ Кларисса - из Швеции.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: God helps those who help themselves.
exercises.ru: На Бога надейся, ___ сам не плошай.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It rarely rains here, but when it does, everything gets flooded.
exercises.ru: Тут редко идёт дождь, ___ когда идёт, то всё заливает.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
